blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Newly named chief justice Rodil Zalameda, 63, is a longtime public servant, having served as city prosecutor and associate justice of the Supreme Court (SC) and the Court of Appeals (CA). Zalameda obtained his law degree from the Ateneo de Manila University in 1987 under a scholarship grant. As a law student, he was active in extracurricular activities, being part of the Ateneo Law Journal and Ateneo Law Bulletin.
